name: Zstandard
summary: Official-source Zstandard 1.5.7 WebAssembly with a bounded browser-core library profile and the original upstream zstd CLI browser-full profile, both published with verified corresponding source and supply-chain metadata.

profiles.label: Browser Core
features: exact upstream libzstd 1.5.7 compression and decompression
profiles.output: Zstandard 1.5.7 one-shot compression/decompression library for browser-local data
profiles.size: Loaded from the published release manifest

profiles.label: Browser Full
features: original upstream zstd command-line source, not a JavaScript reimplementation
normal .zst compression and decompression using staged MEMFS paths
fresh isolated Worker for each CLI invocation
native zstd interoperability tested in both directions on CI
dictionary CLI is compiled but its browser behavior remains an unverified capability
profiles.output: Original upstream zstd CLI for staged browser MEMFS files
profiles.size: Loaded from the published release manifest

comparison.name: Upstream native
comparison.note: Reference libzstd C library and full CLI, native filesystem and optional multithreading.

comparison.name: WASM Zoo
comparison.note: Published browser-core plus original upstream zstd CLI browser-full. The CLI uses browser MEMFS rather than a native OS filesystem and intentionally omits pthreads, legacy-frame decoding and external format codecs.

notes: Published GitHub Release zstd-v0.3.0 contains both browser profiles, exact corresponding official source/build recipe, SHA-256 checksums, standalone in-toto/SLSA provenance and CycloneDX 1.6 SBOMs.
browser-core and browser-full both passed real Chromium operation tests; browser-full also passed bidirectional native zstd frame interoperability before publication.
The public Playground stages only checksum-verified published release assets. Files are processed locally in browser Workers.
No npm package is published yet. npm rollout and the published-registry three-browser compatibility matrix remain a separate reviewed phase.
Automatic upstream candidate promotion is intentionally not enabled yet: candidateMode remains none until the Zstandard adapter/promotion path is separately reviewed.
Both profiles are single-threaded and require no SharedArrayBuffer. browser-full omits native filesystem access, pthreads, external gzip/xz/lz4 codecs and legacy-frame decoding.

@wasm-zoo/zstd@0.3.0 is currently npm pre-publication canary only: a review-only PR tests a packed, immutable-release-derived browser-full tarball in three browsers before an explicitly human-approved initial npm publish.

referenceWasm.name: zstd-codec
referenceWasm.note: The third-party source repository's cpp/zstd submodule points to commit 4fa456d7f12f8b27bd3b2f5dfd4f46898cb31c24 (v1.3.6). This is source-pin evidence, not a binary audit of npm.

capabilityMatrix.note: Both profiles use the official 1.5.7 C sources. Browser-full also requires real CLI compress/decompress and bidirectional native frame compatibility in CI.
The native upstream CLI has file-I/O streaming, including staged MEMFS files. The JS adapter still buffers inputs/outputs and this phase does not assert a streaming JS API or unknown-size test.
The full upstream CLI and libzstd dictionary code are linked, but browser dictionary behavior is not yet tested as a release gate.

capabilityMatrix.feature: Original upstream zstd CLI using MEMFS
capabilityMatrix.note: Builds original upstream programs/*.c including zstdcli.c; arguments and file paths apply to staged Emscripten MEMFS rather than a native host filesystem.
Both profiles are single-threaded in fresh outer Workers. No COOP/COEP required.
No Zoo network access. Each runtime fetches self-hosted local JavaScript/WASM assets.

capabilityMatrix.feature: Native host filesystem and shell pipelines
capabilityMatrix.note: Neither browser profile can access OS files directly; CLI inputs/outputs are staged in MEMFS, and stdout/stderr are captured.

capabilityMatrix.feature: External gzip/xz/lz4 codec formats and legacy-frame decoding
capabilityMatrix.note: The browser-full CLI is compiled without optional native codec libraries, pthreads or legacy-frame code.

integration.summary: Use the published browser-full package to run normal upstream zstd CLI arguments against explicitly staged browser MEMFS files, or use browser-core for bounded in-memory one-shot compression/decompression.
notes: Use the immutable zstd-v0.3.0 GitHub Release assets; the public Playground stages the same verified ZIP contents.
Inputs and outputs use safe browser-local paths. Maximum staged input and collected output remain bounded to 64 MiB by the wrappers.
No native OS filesystem, pthreads or network access is exposed by either browser profile.

docs.description: Unofficial WASM Zoo distribution of the original upstream Zstandard 1.5.7 zstd CLI for browsers.
docs.runtimeNote: Single-threaded original upstream CLI in an isolated Web Worker with MEMFS. Up to 64 MiB staged input and collected output. No SharedArrayBuffer required. Only browser-full is bundled in npm; browser-core is separately downloadable from the immutable GitHub Release. No native filesystem, pthreads, external codecs or legacy-frame decoding.
